open_work.name: Add the home television CRT practice console

full_objective.text: Add an interactable television connected to an old-console-style game system in Motel Room, Apartment and Home, including in-run and meta-home contexts. Interaction opens a dedicated original console-inspired CRT environment titled Beat the House, with selectable entries containing each of the eleven actual playable Games registry names and existing icons. Selecting any game uses its existing production practice/generation path, seed controls, rules and setup. Leave returns to the same CRT selector with useful selection and seed state retained; exiting the CRT returns to the originating room or title screen. The title-screen Games button opens this same environment. Preserve all supported generation seed options/defaults and practice setup, including Scratch Ticket machine stock of 100 of each ticket. Protect live run and meta money, Heat, time, inventory, progression, unlocks, RNG, save state and Continue. Deliver focused durable routing/state-boundary regression coverage, fresh native/Web input and visual acceptance, tested scoped main integration and exact existing NEXT deployment verification for 0.6.1.
